President Donald Trump's support among Republican voters dropped in a new poll less than two months from November's crucial midterm elections. 1 found a near 10 percentage point drop among Republicans who say they "strongly approve" of the president's job performance. In polling conducted in March and April, 52% of Republicans said they strongly approved of the president's performance, compared to 31% who said they somewhat approve.
